import sys,subprocess,re,collections,json
root=sys.argv[1]
for rev in sys.argv[2:]:
 text=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',root,'show',rev+':corpus/SOURCES.md']).decode()
 rows=[s.strip().strip('|').split('|') for s in text.splitlines() if re.match(r'^ {0,3}\|\s*S\d{3,}\s*\|',s)]
 print(json.dumps({'revision':rev,'rows':len(rows),'tiers':dict(collections.Counter(s[3].strip() for s in rows)),'statuses':dict(collections.Counter(s[7].strip() for s in rows))}))
